data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Κλωρις (Kloris), meaning 'light, glory'. In Greek mythology, Cloris was a goddess of the moon, spring, and flowers. The name Cloris carries the meaning “Light, Glory” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cloris usually hope their child will grow to embody light, glory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
